guide.createtransit.index.2: /csu guide bank  - group elevators into a bank
guide.createtransit.elevator.1: Cabin Kit: face where the shaft will go and right-click the floor where the doorway should be. Check the preview (gold doorway, white landing door, blue controller), crouch-right-click to turn it, then right-click the same block again to build.
guide.createtransit.elevator.2: Shaft: stack Elevator Guide Rails straight up from the floor marker above the controller, with no gaps. At each higher floor, use an Elevator Floor Marker Guide Rail at foot level instead of a plain rail. Stop at the top floor and keep the 3x3 shaft clear.
guide.createtransit.elevator.3: Landing doors: at every floor, stand in the hallway facing the shaft and use an Elevator Landing Door Kit on the floor in front of the doorway. On the home floor, use the white outline. Doors link automatically.
guide.createtransit.elevator.4: Activate: right-click the controller, check that Floors lists every stop (F1, F2, ...), then press Activate.
guide.createtransit.elevator.5: Ride: place an Elevator Floor Call beside each landing door (within 6 blocks, at most 2 blocks up). Inside the cabin, tap a floor on the touchscreen.
guide.createtransit.bank.1: Build each elevator first (/csu guide elevator), side by side, with their landing doors on the same hallway wall.
guide.createtransit.bank.2: On the lowest floor they all serve, place an Elevator Floor Call between two neighbouring landing doors.
guide.createtransit.bank.3: Use a Create Wrench on that button and choose Create bank. Wrench the button between the next pair and choose Add adjacent shafts. Repeat until every elevator is in. Buttons on higher floors join automatically.
guide.createtransit.bank.4: Optional: place an Elevator Destination Selector beside a bank landing. Riders pick a floor and are told which car (A, B, ...) to take.
guide.createtransit.bank.5: Joining two banks: wrench a button of the bank whose letters you keep and choose Primary bank. At the other bank choose Preview secondary, then Confirm merge. Undo last merge reverses it.
guide.createtransit.bank.footer: The wrench menu also sets the bank's button style, colours and floor names.
message.createtransit.kit.rail_mount_blo: Clear one block directly below the guide rail column for the controller.
message.createtransit.kit.rail_cabin_cre: Cabin created on this rail. Place a Landing Door Kit at each floor, then click the cabin to choose a floor. Use the kit on the rail again to customise it.
message.createtransit.kit.turned: Preview turned. Right-click the same block again to build it.
message.createtransit.kit.doorway_blocke: Click an empty floor spot: the block above it becomes the doorway, so it must be clear.
message.createtransit.kit.preview: Preview: the cabin goes straight ahead, with its door where you clicked. Gold = doorway, white = landing door, blue = controller. Crouch-right-click to turn it; right-click the same block again to build.
message.createtransit.kit.controller_blo: Can't build here: the controller (blue box) and the block above it must be empty.
message.createtransit.kit.built: Cabin Kit built. Next: build the guide-rail shaft up from the marker, put a Landing Door Kit in the white outline at each floor, then press Activate here. Type /csu guide elevator for every step.
message.createtransit.landing.linked: Landing door linked to the elevator.
message.createtransit.landing.unlinked: Landing door placed, but no elevator lines up with it yet. It links by itself once it sits in front of a cabin doorway at a floor marker (the Cabin Kit preview shows the spot in white). You can also link it with a Create Wrench.
message.createtransit.controller.deactiv: Deactivate the cabin first: right-click the controller, press Deactivate, then break it.
